It leaves out an inline whose model the user may not view, change, add or delete, and sets `max_num` to 0 on one whose objects the user may not add (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.get_inline_instances`).

`InlineModelAdmin.get_formset` gathers the arguments of `inlineformset_factory` from the inline's hooks and calls it with the parent's model and the child's (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:InlineModelAdmin.get_formset`).

A formset leaves forms ticked for deletion out of `BaseFormSet.is_valid`, but `BaseModelFormSet.clean` calls `BaseModelFormSet.validate_unique`, which asks every form whether it is valid; the exception escapes, and `BaseFormSet.full_clean` keeps it as an error of the whole formset (`django/forms/models.py:BaseModelFormSet.validate_unique`, `django/forms/formsets.py:BaseFormSet.full_clean`).

It takes each formset class and its inline from `ModelAdmin.get_formsets_with_inlines` and binds it with what `ModelAdmin.get_formset_kwargs` returns: the parent as `instance=`, the prefix, the inline's `InlineModelAdmin.get_queryset`, empty for a user who may neither view nor change, and for a `"POST"` a copy of the data, the files, and `save_as_new=True` when `"_saveasnew"` was pressed (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin._create_formsets`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.get_formset_kwargs`).

It takes each formset class and its inline from `ModelAdmin.get_formsets_with_inlines` and binds it with what `ModelAdmin.get_formset_kwargs` returns: the parent as `instance=`, the prefix, the inline's `InlineModelAdmin.get_queryset`, empty for a user who may neither view nor change, and for a `"POST"` a copy of the data, the files, and `save_as_new=True` when `"_saveasnew"` was pressed (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin._create_formsets`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.get_formset_kwargs`).

The inline's add, change and delete permissions count only when the user may change the parent, or add it on an add page; otherwise all three are false and the formset's `extra` and `max_num` are set to 0 ([Permissions in the admin: `has_change_permission` and the others](admin-permissions.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.get_inline_formsets`).

Each walks its fieldsets as `InlineFieldset`s, which leave out the foreign key to the parent; the templates put it, and the child's key where needed, in hidden inputs (`django/contrib/admin/helpers.py:InlineAdminFormSet.__iter__`, `django/contrib/admin/helpers.py:InlineFieldset.__iter__`).

Each walks its fieldsets as `InlineFieldset`s, which leave out the foreign key to the parent; the templates put it, and the child's key where needed, in hidden inputs (`django/contrib/admin/helpers.py:InlineAdminFormSet.__iter__`, `django/contrib/admin/helpers.py:InlineFieldset.__iter__`).

The change form includes each inline's `template`: `"admin/edit_inline/tabular.html"`, a table with a row for each form and headings from `InlineAdminFormSet.fields`, or `"admin/edit_inline/stacked.html"`, each form a block of its own (`django/contrib/admin/templates/admin/edit_inline/`).

A click copies the row `"ships-empty"`, puts the next index in place of `"__prefix__"`, and adds one to `"TOTAL_FORMS"`; removing a new row numbers the rest again (`django/contrib/admin/static/admin/js/inlines.js`).

Once the parent's form and every formset are valid and the parent is saved, `ModelAdmin.save_related` saves each formset through `ModelAdmin.save_formset`, which calls the formset's `save` ([The change form: `changeform_view`](change-form.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.save_related`).

The parent's change message gains an entry for each object a formset added, changed or deleted, in the parent's row of the log ([The log and the history: `LogEntry` and `history_view`](log.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/utils.py:construct_change_message`).
